s1.desc: a kitchen with a long cyan counter, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a bedroom with a yellow bed, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with jars, bottles, a mixing bowl and a tray of eggs on the counter

beats.text: Pax stands at the kitchen counter with his back turned, busily cooking as bits of food splash up around him

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: ECC on the counter at both sides scale 1.003 at f4 to 1.031 at f22, ty -29 px; compare 0/23 shows doubled counter edges. Skit is a Valentine's bouquet ad: the plush bouquet (lead_copy) and a product photo end card follow
10 frames of a small settling push-in at the start of the close-up (ECC bottom band scale 1.003 at f26 to 1.0073 at f34, then held)

spans.view: with a wooden tray of breakfast food on the messy counter in front of him and a round table and chair behind him

beats.text: Pax stands behind a tray of breakfast food with food smudges on his face and a sweat drop, blinking
Pax closes his eyes and wipes his brow with a flipper, flicking the sweat away
Pax opens his eyes and narrows them with a wobbly, tired smile
Pax puts his flippers on his hips and beams proudly at the breakfast tray

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC vs f36 on the counter-front band and on the table band scale 1.0000, under 0.5 px at cc 1.000 f44-84

spans.view: with an open wooden door in an arched doorway behind him and the soft-focus end of the bed in the foreground

beats.text: Pax steps out from behind the open door carrying a wooden tray of breakfast food
Pax waddles forward into the bedroom holding the tray out in both flippers

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 87/121 keeps the door, arch and floor edges black (ECC on the blurred bed band is noisy, not used). Pax grows a little as he walks toward the viewer. A light switch on the wall

spans.view: with a nightstand holding a peach lamp and a small yellow duck figurine beside the bed

beats.text: Polly sits up in bed rubbing her eye sleepily as Pax stands beside the bed holding a tray of breakfast
Pax leans in and sets the tray down on the blanket in front of Polly
Pax straightens up beside the bed with a smile while Polly looks at him and holds a flipper to her cheek

spans.notes: camera locked: ECC on the bed-foot band scale 1.000x, under 2 px at cc >= 0.99 f130-178; compare 122/173 overlaps. Ends at f174 where the plush bouquet (lead_copy) starts to come out from behind Pax

the Valentine plush bouquet with a Pax plush and a Polly plush holding a red heart: Pax holds it out f174-180, close-up of it with sparkles after the cut at f181 (static to ~f205, then a pull-back f205-210), then Polly in bed with the bouquet on the nightstand and in her flippers until she knocks the tray into the air f245-251. Hard cut at f252 (missed by profile: same plain background). The bouquet is Pudgy's own plush product (also ad_merch); lead_copy ranks first

spans.view: with the foot of the bed and a round bedpost knob in the foreground

beats.text: Pax throws up his flippers with wide eyes as the breakfast tray tumbles through the air above him
Pax grabs the falling tray and catches the plate on it
Pax shifts the tray from side to side, catching the pieces of food as they rain down onto it
Pax stands at the foot of the bed holding the full tray, blinking with a relieved look

spans.notes: camera locked: compare 252/295 keeps the bed and bedpost edges black (ECC on the bed band fails with the flying food, not used). No bouquet in view
wide bed shot again: Polly hugs the plush bouquet (Pax and Polly plushes) while Pax sets the tray beside her and kisses her cheek
product photo end card: the real plush bouquet on a pedestal against a rose backdrop, with logo, product text and a slow push-in. Also ad_merch, graphic_overlay and lead_copy; off_style ranks first
